lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: After our performance, I went to the green room,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: and there were all these snacks laid out on the table.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I was told they were from you.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Is that true?
Yes.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Blanc and I were so surprised,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: you should have seen our faces.
A small token of my gratitude for you both putting on such a marvelous performance.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Aw, Pit Boss,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: you're gonna make us cry by saying stuff like that.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Where did you get all this, anyway?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: It's all from famous stores where you have to line up outside to get in,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: and there's so much of it!
It was nothing.
I asked Neon and Anis to stand in line.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Oh my gosh...

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I think I might have to redo my makeup.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: You're making me all emotional, and I've still got another performance coming up!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Lol!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Oh my goodness! Well, I feel bad for them having to wait for so long, but thank you all the same, Pit Boss.
You both put on a spectacular performance.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Thank you, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Blanc and I will both keep working hard so that we can keep putting on great shows.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: As for these snacks, I'm going to enjoy them greatly.
Please do, and break a leg out there.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Thanks!
